- Waterproof phone case
- Beach bag / tote

========================================

- Aloe vera gel / after-sun lotion
- Insect repellent

- Toothbrush & toothpaste

- Hair ties / clips
- Razor
- Personal medications

========================================
- First aid kit (band-aids, antiseptic wipes, pain relievers)

- Prescription medications
- Hand sanitizer
- Face masks (optional)
- Travel insurance information

ELECTRONICS
========================================
- Camera (with extra memory cards and batteries)
- Phone and charger
- Portable power bank

- Headphones / earbuds
- Travel adapter (if needed)

TRAVEL DOCUMENTS & ESSENTIALS
========================================
- Passport / government ID
- Flight tickets / boarding passes
- Hotel reservation confirmations

- Credit cards and cash
- Driver's license (for road trip)
- Printed itinerary
- Emergency contact list

- Reusable water bottle
- Snacks for hikes and road trip
- Sunglasses
- Hat / cap (for sun protection)
- Light rain jacket (just in case)
- Small umbrella
- Book / e-reader (for relaxation day at the spa)
- Journal / travel diary
- Reusable shopping bag (for shopping at Ala Moana Center)

========================================
MISCELLANEOUS
========================================
- Laundry bag
- Ziplock bags (various sizes)
- Travel pillow (for the flight)
- Earplugs
- Pen (for filling out forms)
